item.text: The example compares **Upgrade 12—attic insulation for unfinished attics—against the baseline**, using **single-family detached buildings**. It zooms in on **July 8–15, 2018**, with timestamp bounds `2018-07-08 00:15:00` through `2018-07-16 00:00:00` (EST). See the notebook’s dataset-selection and zoom-in cells in the [source notebook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/ResStock.github.io/696c020d696137830ddae75abbfb477ae7af8eaa/docs/resources/how-to-guides/access_timeseries_data_programmatically.ipynb).
